name: Default
shortDescription: Web UI built on yt-dlp that downloads single videos and playlists, with language, subtitle, quality and cutting options, into an organized folder layout ready for a home media server.

alerts.message: HomeTube has no built-in login: anyone who can reach the URL can start downloads on the server. Put it behind access control if the domain is public.

YouTube often blocks downloads from server IPs without cookies. Export a cookies.txt file from a browser signed in to YouTube and place it at /config/youtube_cookies.txt on the hometube-config volume; HomeTube picks it up automatically.
